text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, that beauty mark under your eye is 
charming as ever. Nice accent!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...If just one of them is this charming— 
then maybe having even more could make it 
even more appealing...?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... This isn't how it was supposed 
to look?! ...Wait, it won't come off?! 
This is permanent marker!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After caking on makeup to hide the pen 
marks... Seeking the Pearl couldn't stop 
worrying about her face. It turned into a 
day completely devoid of focus...
